hints.title: Multi-Pointer Extension of Ugly Numbers
hints.text: Every super ugly number is formed by multiplying a previously generated super ugly number by one of the prime factors in primes.

hints.title: Dedicated Pointer per Prime Candidate
hints.text: Maintain an array of index pointers corresponding to each prime. Advance the pointers whose product with their referenced ugly number matches the minimum next value.

hints.title: Tabulated Sequence Construction
hints.text: Initialize dp of size n with dp[0] = 1, and indices array of zeros of size len(primes). For i from 1 to n - 1, find minimum over dp[indices[j]] * primes[j], assign to dp[i], and increment matching indices.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: index of super ugly number sought
complexity.notes: Optimal dynamic programming solution running in O(N * K) time with O(N + K) auxiliary memory.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing integers sequentially with trial division is exceedingly slow as ugly numbers become sparse.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: K pointers maintain sorted multi-way merge order without duplicate insertion into priority queues.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should increment all matching prime pointers simultaneously to naturally deduplicate multiples.
